text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein and Queen Noor leave on a short private visit to the United Kingdom.
- Prime Minister Kabariti discusses with Saleh Salim, an Israeli Arab Knesset member, developing the Middle East peace process on the Palestinian track.

- Jordan Electricity Company workers strike continues for second day, say they may resort to cutting electricity if they are pressured further. A meeting with justice minister to resolve dispute cancelled.
- Parliamentary deputy Nazeeh Amareen, who submitted his resignation in protest over government's handling of last August's civil disturbances says he is still insisting on tendering his resignation.
- Kabariti says during a meeting with a visiting senior U.S. State Department official that Jordan highly appreciates the status of the kingdom as a major non-NATO ally of the U.S.
